description: This file defines the Response class within the WebSockets::JsonRpc namespace. The class inherits from a JSONRPC::Message base class and provides methods related to handling JSON-RPC responses, including retrieving the ID, checking if the response contains a result or error, and validating the response.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Represents a JSON-RPC response message, providing methods to access response details such as ID, result, error, and validity.

methods.name: Response
methods.description: Default constructor for the Response class.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the response.

methods.name: isResult
methods.description: Checks whether the response contains a result.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Retrieves the result object from the response.

methods.name: isError
methods.description: Checks whether the response indicates an error.

methods.name: getError
methods.description: Retrieves the error object from the response.
